baseline_note: Checkout adds quality rubric only; inspected product files have no diff from baseline. No shared files edited.
evidence_scope: Real web frontend in headless Chromium on macOS, Windows and Mac user agents, in-memory IPC. Browser UI observations and IPC routing do not establish native Windows or actual file-transfer safety.

checks.covers: Windows Explorer layout, address/history, tabs, sorting/view, copy state, preview/details, home/network, Mac columns regression, title-bar commands and 440/560/740 px control bounds

Multiple device connections and tabs; transfer source/destination provenance, native-drop message confirmation/cancel routing, cancellation routing by device, delayed preview, cancelled connection recovery, drag-to-device setup

checks.result: Expected reproduction timeout clicking offscreen narrow details close button; second probe resizes to continue

findings.title: Small-window details/preview pane occupies zero-width offscreen column
findings.repro: At 560x650 Windows UA launch Studio Mac, select Notes.txt and click details. Pane hidden=false but bounds x=560,width=1,right=561; actual content invisible. Close control times out as offscreen/intercepted.
findings.fix: At <=600px show preview/details as a visible overlay or full-width panel with reachable close control; test content and close-button bounds, not only toolbar bounds.

findings.title: Global file shortcuts hijack focused toolbar button activation
findings.repro: Select Notes.txt, focus data-action=new. Space opens preview and produces no menu; Enter sends files op=open path=/Users/alex/Notes.txt instead of opening New menu. Reproduced at 800 px after restoring viewport.
findings.fix: Honor focused buttons and interactive widgets before routing unmodified Space/Enter/navigation keys to file commands. Verify New, view, tabs and close via keyboard.

findings.title: Narrow Explorer hides all local/device navigation without a compact replacement
findings.repro: At <=600 px sidebar is display:none. Home, This PC, local Downloads/Documents and device links live there; More menu contains no replacement. Address root is a plain span. Starting in remote home leaves resizing, split-view workaround, or prior setup needed to choose normal local target.
findings.fix: Provide reachable compact Locations/Home menu or drawer with local drives, favorites and other devices when sidebar is hidden; verify remote-to-local target choice at 560 px without resizing.

findings.title: Transfer confirmation lacks accessible dialog/select names and focus return
findings.repro: Copy Notes.txt then paste. Both prompt container and inner dialog have role=null. policy and engine selects have labels=[] because adjacent labels are not associated. Cancel returns activeElement to BODY.
findings.fix: Add role=dialog, aria-modal and labelled title; associate select labels with ids; save initiating focus and restore it on every exit. Verify with accessibility tree and representative screen reader.

findings.title: Forced delta transfer is offered in combinations that necessarily fail
findings.repro: Confirmation defaults to keep-both yet engine menu always offers rsync. Backend requires replace policy, copy rather than move, local-to-remote direction, usable rsync and no Windows normalization tree. Selecting forced rsync with default keep cannot succeed; explanation only says rsync required.
findings.fix: Explain eligibility before submission and disable invalid forced-rsync choices, especially keep/skip, move, remote-to-remote and Korean normalization. Keep automatic fallback understandable; verify actual eligible delta transfer separately.
